**BREAKING: The Inner Circle Condemns Hawaza, Pushes for Removal From Community**

The Inner Circle (TIC) has condemned Hawaza members over sexually inappropriate remarks, saying they broke both Discord's and Slop Company's rules.

In a statement given to BCBN, TIC leadership said the remarks were disrespectful and unacceptable, and pointed to Discord's Community Guidelines, which prohibit harassment, including sexual harassment, and restrict sexually explicit content from being shown to users under 18. TIC said it will hold talks with higher-ups to get those involved removed from the Build and Conquer community, and will push for them to be punished on Discord as well.

TIC said its goal is not to start drama or target individuals, but to ensure community rules apply equally to everyone.

More information will follow.

Journalists: @Pampelasche

**Hawaza Responds to The Inner Circle's Condemnation**

Hawaza has pushed back against The Inner Circle's condemnation, arguing that one member's actions do not represent the whole faction.

Hawaza's Marshal, barbroza1111, said the faction has already banned the member responsible. He also accused a member of RUOT and the NATO of using multiple slurs, saying the same standard should apply to other factions.

RUOT and the NATO have not responded to the accusation.

**RUOT Leader Accuses Hawazan of Threats and a Faked Image of Him Betraying an Ally (ACCUSATION)**

A RUOT leader has told BCBN that Hawazan threatened him in DMs and created an AI-generated image of him betraying an ally. He wants the matter published and says game admins should know, because it "crosses lines even outside of B&C."

One screenshot shows a conversation between the RUOT leader and a Hawazan leader, or a higher-up in Hawazan. In it, the RUOT leader says troops "can be withdrawn as early as today." The screenshot was posted by a NATO member, who described it as a representative of Hawazan. Another version of the screenshot circulating in the conflict has been edited. The RUOT leader says the edited one is fake and has shared what he says is the real, unedited conversation.

He also forwarded a DM screenshot between a Hawazan member and the leader of NATO. In it, the NATO leader accuses the Hawazan member of "using AI to try to break the coalition." The Hawazan member replies that they didn't send the image and don't know what the NATO leader is talking about.

BCBN hasn't independently verified any of these screenshots, and we can't confirm who made or edited them.

We'll update this story when we have more.

**BREAKING: RUOT Declares War on the Republic of Dominia**

The Republic of Dominia has announced a state of emergency after the Russian Union of Trade (RUOT) declared war on it. Dominia says RUOT has declared a full-scale war against it, and that its people will "fight till the end" even though RUOT outnumbers them.

According to Dominia's leader, the declaration came not long after Dominia spoke out and clarified its neutrality in the Hawazan conflict. He says RUOT views Dominia's diplomatic relationship with Hawazan as a "strategic relationship," even though Dominia says it hasn't provided Hawazan with anything.

Dominia disputes RUOT's claim that it sent Dominia a "request." Its leader says it was a warning with threats against the faction. He accuses RUOT of silencing a faction for speaking out, comparing RUOT to communists, and says Dominia is a victim.

Dominia asks other factions to consider their actions carefully. It says that although Hawazan is allegedly a cause of the conflicts, Dominia hasn't supported the war or taken part in it, and being declared war on is "deeply concerning." The leader also says he feels sorry for Hawazan for being caught in the middle.

RUOT hasn't responded to Dominia's statement yet, and BCBN hasn't independently verified either side's claims. We'll update this story when RUOT responds.

**UPDATE: RUOT Side Tells Dominia Hostilities Are "None" After Review**

RUOT and its allies have responded to Dominia after Dominia said it was at war with RUOT.

In a conversation screenshot, a representative on the RUOT side told a Dominia representative that "this conversation has been reviewed and hostilities are none." The Dominia representative asked, "So, do we have peace now?" The reply was "Mhm."

This suggests the war RUOT declared on Dominia has ended, or that the two sides now see themselves as at peace. Neither side has issued an official statement confirming it.

BCBN hasn't independently verified the screenshot, and we're waiting for official statements from RUOT and Dominia on whether the war is over. We'll update this story as soon as we have them.

The screenshot only shows two usernames and their role tags, not their factions. I went with your description that this is RUOT and allies replying to Dominia, so check that and tell me if the reps are from different factions.

**Hawaza Blames Former Member for AI-Generated Images**

Hawaza High Command has blamed a former member, MBS, for the AI-generated images at the center of RUOT's accusations, saying he acted without the knowledge or approval of Hawaza's leadership.

In an official statement posted by Marshal barbroza1111, Hawaza said MBS had offered to help negotiate a peace treaty with RUOT and was allowed to assist, but then used AI to frame people behind the leadership's back. According to Hawaza, MBS left the faction once his actions were exposed. Hawaza said the incident was not an organized or faction-wide attack and that MBS's actions do not represent the faction.

The statement follows a BCBN report in which a RUOT leader accused Hawaza of threatening him and creating an AI-generated image of him betraying an ally.

**Update: NATO Leader Reportedly Banned, Quits Build and Conquer**

NATO's leader, SRC_Dragnov, was reportedly banned for paying people to join and stay in the faction, which breaks Roblox's Terms of Service, according to two sources. Slop Company has not officially commented on the ban.

Dragnov has since announced that he is quitting Build and Conquer. In a message seen by BCBN, he said people had laughed at him because he was planning to pay one of his faction members to stay in NATO, and criticized the community. He did not say whether he had been banned.

Earlier this day, NATO offered 2,000 to 3,000 Robux to new members with more than 60B in-game currency as part of a recruitment drive after falling to 7th place in the faction rankings.

NATO was fully disbanded earlier today, in the middle of its war with Hawaza.

Journalists: @Pampelasche

**BREAKING: RUOT Withdraws From Hawaza War, Dissolves Coalition**

The Russian Union of Trade (RUOT) has withdrawn from its war with Hawaza and dissolved the RUOT Coalition, according to a statement from RUOT's founder, Light.

Light said the conflict had split the community in half and led factions such as Black Cat Central to become hostile. He added that RUOT had faced public criticism, including slurs, and that its military will be defunded. Light took full responsibility for the decision and asked RUOT's former coalition partners to withdraw from the war as well, while urging them not to cut ties with RUOT.

In the statement, Light maintained his accusations of war crimes against Hawaza's leadership, but said RUOT could no longer fight a war the community did not support. He also apologized to Dominia for messages RUOT sent to its government in anger.

Light said he is now considering disbanding RUOT entirely.

Hawaza remains at war with the UDC.

More information will follow.

Journalists: @Pampelasche

**Hawazan Issues "Wanted" Notice Targeting GIE and RUOT Leaders**

Hawazan's Ministry of Interior has announced "the beginning of the persecution and arrest of every aggressor." It calls the target factions "hostile and aggressor factions."

The notice lists its targets in order:

1. The leaders of the Greater Israeli Empire (GIE) and the Russian Union of Trade (RUOT).
2. Members of GIE and RUOT.
3. Their remaining allies, "the remains of NATO," and everyone who helped GIE and RUOT or attacked Hawazan's allies.

It ends with: "We will not forgive and we will not make any peace with those who were our enemy and tried to destroy our reputation."

BCBN hasn't independently verified the notice, and it doesn't say how any arrests would be carried out. GIE and RUOT haven't responded yet. We'll update this story when they do.

**BREAKING: Greater American Empire Withdraws From the Hawaza War**

The Greater American Empire (GAE) has announced it is withdrawing from the war against Hawaza, effective immediately. The statement is dated October 27, 2026.

GAE has told all its personnel to stop attacking Hawaza's troops, bases, resource production and economic infrastructure. Earlier orders for offensive action against Hawaza are rescinded, including standing or scheduled tasking under Operation Hail Tear.

GAE says the decision follows reports of RUOT's withdrawal and the dissolution of its coalition. It says it will end its own involvement and pursue any further discussions through diplomatic channels. Members must report any ongoing engagement to their commanding officer and disengage.

GAE keeps the right to defend its members and territory if attacked. Any further offensive action needs new authorization from Imperial leadership.

The statement also says reports indicate that GIE intends to keep fighting, and that hostilities involving Hawaza and the UDC remain ongoing. GAE says its withdrawal is an independent decision and doesn't establish a ceasefire or peace agreement for other factions.

BCBN hasn't independently verified the statement, and GAE's claims about RUOT's withdrawal and its coalition dissolving are unconfirmed. We'll update this story as other factions respond.

**Cold Front Alliance (UN) Announces Court Against Hawazan Over Illegal Wars on Neutral Countries**

The Cold Front Alliance (UN) has announced a court against Hawazan for its actions in the current conflict.

The charge is illegal wars against neutral countries. Hawazan faces fines of 5,000,000,000 to 10,000,000,000. If the fines aren't paid, the alliance says it will impose a trade embargo for 14 real days.

Three judges have been named. The date of the court will be announced tomorrow.

BCBN hasn't independently verified the court or the alliance's authority to enforce the fines or embargo, and Hawazan hasn't responded yet. We'll update this story when the date is set and when Hawazan responds.

**RUOT Will Not Disband, Warns Hawazan of Higher Fines**

The Russian Union of Trade (RUOT) has announced it will not disband, after a vote on the faction's future.

In a statement to its members and allies, RUOT said the dissolution of its coalition and its withdrawal from the conflict weren't enough for Hawazan, which it says wants to keep attacking members of the former coalition. Based on the current vote, RUOT's leadership says it will end the vote with the conclusion not to disband.

RUOT says its government has completely defunded the military. It also says that withdrawing from the conflict doesn't mean it won't return "stronger than last time" if it has to.

RUOT has issued a formal notice to Hawazan. If Hawazan stays hostile after the coalition's withdrawal, RUOT says it will raise the fines it is seeking from 5B-10B to 20B-30B.

BCBN hasn't independently verified RUOT's claims about Hawazan's actions, and Hawazan hasn't responded yet. We'll update this story when it does.

**Hawazan Responds to Cold Front Alliance Court: "We Will Not Accept a Predetermined Verdict"**

Hawazan has responded to the Cold Front Alliance's (UN) announcement of a court against it. Hawazan acknowledges the announcement but rejects any attempt to impose fines before a fair and impartial hearing.

Hawazan is demanding three things:

- Clear evidence supporting the allegations.
- The legal basis for the charges.
- Clarification of the Cold Front Alliance's authority to impose such penalties.

Hawazan says it will defend its position in court and will not accept a predetermined verdict.

The Cold Front Alliance hasn't responded to Hawazan's demands, and the court date hasn't been announced. BCBN hasn't independently verified either side's claims. We'll update this story when the date is set.

**European Union Orders Two-Day Ceasefire Between Hawazan and RUOT**

The European Union (EU) has issued a ceasefire order. It orders Hawazan to observe a two-day ceasefire with the Russian Union of Trade (RUOT), effective immediately.

The EU says it has diplomatic alliances with both factions and wants to act as a neutral mediator. During the two days, it says it will work to facilitate diplomatic talks, address both sides' concerns and negotiate an agreement to end the war. It says the order isn't meant to undermine either alliance or favor one side.

The EU is also calling on Hawazan and RUOT to show "discipline, responsibility, and respect for their existing diplomatic commitments." It says military confrontation shouldn't be the only way to resolve disagreements when peaceful options remain. It says it is ready to help both parties reach a settlement, but that this depends on both sides honoring the ceasefire and taking part in negotiations sincerely.

The order is signed by the presidents of the EU, Hawazan and RUOT. BCBN hasn't independently verified it or the signatures.

We'll update this story when the ceasefire ends or a settlement is reached.

**BREAKING: TPE Withdraws From the Hawazan War**

The TPE administration has announced its official withdrawal from the war against Hawazan, effective immediately.

TPE says the decision follows substantial changes in the conflict, including the Russian Union of Trade's (RUOT's) decision to withdraw and dissolve its coalition. Given RUOT's central role in the war, TPE says continued military involvement is no longer in its best interests.

It says the decision protects its members, preserves its resources and prioritizes the faction's long-term stability. TPE thanked its allies for their cooperation, asked everyone to respect the decision and said it will now focus on its own development.

It closed with: "TPE chooses stability and its people's interests above a war that no longer aligns with its strategic priorities."

BCBN hasn't independently verified the statement. We'll update this story as more factions respond.

**RUOT Cuts Diplomatic Ties With Hawaza, Hawaza Responds**

The Russian Union of Trade (RUOT) has ended all diplomatic relations with Hawaza and no longer recognizes it as a legitimate faction.

In an official notice, RUOT said it will not negotiate with Hawaza, consider diplomatic proposals from it, or treat it as a recognized faction in future political affairs. RUOT said Hawaza had lost its standing through its conduct and its repeated rejection of peaceful solutions.

The Hawaza Administration responded that RUOT's decision does not affect its legitimacy or strength, and that it will not seek recognition from a faction it said had chosen hostility over diplomacy. Hawaza said it will not give in to political pressure and will decide its own future.

The exchange follows RUOT's withdrawal from the war against Hawaza and the dissolution of the RUOT Coalition earlier this week.

Journalists: @Pampelasche
